name: card_browser_chat
description: When the user wants to browse the full credit-card catalogue (e.g. 'show me all credit card offers', 'what cards do you have'), this agent extracts the user's intent, dispatches to the card_offer tool to fetch the catalogue, and returns the list. Use when the user wants to see options, NOT when they want a tailored recommendation.
search_hint: show me cards list cards browse catalogue all credit card offers what cards available card list

data.label: Extract intent
Decline politely
data.text_template: It sounded like you want a personalized credit-card pick rather than the full catalogue. Hand the user back to the orchestrator so it can route to the recommender agent.

data.label: Return the catalogue
data.text_template:
Here are the credit-card offers available right now: {{variables.offers.offers}}.

Summarize them as a short bulleted list for the user (name + one-line headline benefit each), and offer to compare any two if they want.
